purpose: Test the V51 causal branch by retraining the V50 bounded-logit mixture from the same initialization with only the standardized V41 structure-risk channel fixed to zero throughout train, fixed validation diagnostics, and inference, while holding all other information, support, optimization, donor ranks, controls, and gates fixed.

single_changed_factor.channel: standardized V41 full extreme-structure block-risk input channel at index 5
single_changed_factor.V50: observed train-only cached risk value standardized by the immutable V45 condition mean and standard deviation
single_changed_factor.V52: exact floating-point zero after immutable standardization
scope: every development candidate and control sample
every future independent query if and only if V52 passes development and access is explicitly approved
single_changed_factor.meaning: zero is the immutable standardized mean-risk condition, not raw physical risk zero

active_channels: object log10 mean delta squared prediction broadcast over 64^3
conditioning.fixed_zero_channel: V41 full extreme-structure block probability lifted from 16^3 to 64^3
conditioning.standardization: exact immutable V45 train-only condition scalars and target mean and standard deviation

likelihood_and_network.likelihood: unchanged V50 five-component Gaussian mixture in latent x=logit((z-lower)/(upper-lower)) with exact Jacobian
likelihood_and_network.architecture: unchanged V50 three-dimensional residual U-Net including the unused seventh input-channel weights
likelihood_and_network.initialization: same V50 seed 144044, transformed output biases, and initialization call order
likelihood_and_network.objective: same equal-source exact bounded-mixture negative log likelihood

training.mixed_precision: unchanged CUDA autocast plus GradScaler path; transformed log probability and Jacobian remain float32
training.AMP_overflow_accounting: record every scale reduction and nonfinite pre-clip gradient without emitting non-standard JSON numeric tokens; do not alter the V50 optimizer or EMA update order
training.augmentation: uniform one of the same 48 signed cube isometries applied jointly to the six active condition fields, fixed-zero risk field, and target
training.validation: fixed diagnostic transformed NLL at steps 4000, 8000, and 12000; never used for stopping, selection, support, or hyperparameter changes

sampling.candidate: same-voxel monotone bounded-mixture CDF inversion of the unchanged paired V31 donor conditional-rank field with risk fixed to standardized zero
sampling.inverse: unchanged 28-step latent Gaussian-mixture inverse at rank epsilon 1e-7 followed by the exact frozen sigmoid support transform
sampling.post_sample: undo immutable V45 standardization and apply one exact residual DC projection before adding the unchanged query backbone

matched_arms.no_risk_query_local_mixture_copula: actual V52 query-local latent parameters with channel 5 fixed to standardized zero and unchanged paired donor ranks; the only selectable arm
matched_arms.rolled_parameter_control: periodically roll all 15 V52 latent parameter fields by (16,8,4) native voxels while retaining the no-risk query, backbone, and donor rank
matched_arms.sealed_V50_risk_model_reference: reuse only the immutable V50 development decision and its bound metrics and hashes; do not resample or reevaluate V50

development_evaluation.primary_pass: no_risk_query_local_mixture_copula passes field, Q3, and Q4 independently in every domain
development_evaluation.V50_comparison: strictly compare absolute q99.999 error, generated maximum excess, and absolute log generated-over-truth mean delta squared ratio in every domain

fixed_branches.condition: Q3 and Q4 pass every domain but any field check fails
V52 strictly improves absolute q99.999 error, maximum excess, and absolute log mean-delta-squared ratio over sealed V50 in every domain but primary_pass is false
V52 improves Q4 over V50 in every domain but high-k power or residual RMS fails anywhere
sealed V50 equals or improves all three extreme comparisons in every domain
rolled parameter control equals or improves V52 Q3 and Q4 jointly in every domain

hard_preflight: full pytest and clean committed worktree
exact V51 record and audit, V50 program, result record, checkpoint, report, preflight and decision, immutable support artifact, and conditioning-cache hashes and canonical digests
prove channel 5 is exactly zero for real TNG100, SIMBA, and Swift train and validation conditions while every other channel and target exactly equals V50 preprocessing
prove the original cached risk channel is nonconstant so the intervention is substantive
prove all source-balanced real train targets lie strictly inside the unchanged frozen support with no clipping
prove initial parameters and output biases equal V50 under seed 144044 and all 8490415 parameters remain trainable
network shape, finite bounded likelihood, nonzero finite gradients, and CDF inverse consistency
one real source-balanced GPU step with peak allocated memory below 24 GiB
one real paired-donor no-risk sample is finite, remains strictly inside support before DC projection, has no rank permutation, and residual DC below 1e-7 after projection
